: HSV phagocytosed by CD34+ cells → travel to epidermis → transfer HSV DNA to keratinocytes → HSV gene expression in skin → IFN-γ response to viral Ag → epidermal damage + inflam infiltrate
sus cytotoxic immune response vs keratinocytes w foreign viral or drug Ag
· well defined borders - occasionally only 2 zones
•acute onset · symmetric · papular · <3cm - begin on extensor surfaces of acral extremities → centripetal spread - ± face · trunk · palms · soles & flexor surfaces
•variety: target lesions · erythematous papules & macules · urticaria-like lesions · vesicles · bullae
•targets start as dusky red round macules/papules w pruritus & burning → central erythematous area + pale edematous ring + sharp discrete ring of erythema - central lesion 1-3cm
•sudden onset - symmetric on palms · soles · backs of hands & ft · extensor forearms & legs - appear in crops - resolve w.in 1-2wks w.o scarring
•may have sxs of underlying cause first (ex, cough & fever w PNA) - examine oral cavity for bullae & erosions
•minor: localized eruption - lesions aSx or burning & itching
•major: ≥1 mucous membrane involved - painful oral · ocular or genital erosions · diffuse mucosal erythema · bullae
*HFMD · RMSF & 2ndry syphilis also → rash on palms/soles - 3-zone target lesion only in EM
ddx 2ndry syphilis: T. pallidum (spirochete) - diffuse symmetric maculopapular rash incl palms · soles · mucosa - RPR/VDRL for screening
Bx if dx ⍉clear - can detect HSV DNA
bx: interface rxn w necrotic keratinocytes - confirms dx
viral cx & direct immunofluorescence → r/o HSV in suspicious vesicles & erosions
Presumptive dx: acute onset of multi classic lesions
or topical abx applied to eroded areas · IVF for pts w mucositis & poor PO intake · antihist if pruritic
•topical abx for ruptured blisters & eroded skin → prevent 2ndry bact infect
•antiseptic mouthwash → promotes heal of oral lesions
: acyclovir - children: 20mg/kg/d x6mo - ⍉response in 6mo → ↑dose → diff antiviral if still inadeq
•recurr EM: cont antiviral tx (PO acyclovir · valacyclovir · famciclovir as cont suppressive tx → ↓recurr)
•refractory to antivirals: immunomodulators (mycophenolate mofetil · dapsone · azathioprine)
: may be unable to tolerate PO food/drink → hsp for nutrition & pain control + PO glucocorticoids
Rare hypersensitivity rxns affecting skin & mucosal membranes
continuum of serious mucocut rxns w epidermal detachment & necrosis - any age - F > M - ↑risk: IS · active CA · HIV · autoimmune (SLE) · genetic factors
•sulfonamides (SMX · sulfasalazine) · anticonvuls (lamotrigine · phenytoin) · NSAIDs (piroxicam · tenoxicam) · allopurinol
(M. pneumoniae · influenza) - infect (esp M. pneumoniae) = 2nd MC trigger - ~1/3 of pediatric cases ⍉clear trigger - also CMV · strep · syphilis · TB
*Generally develops w.in 2mo of drug initiation, & often w.in first 1-4wks
- USU 4d-4wks of 1st cont use - unlikely w prolonged tx
TEN mortality 30-50% - ~100% if TEN ← acute GVHD - acute phase ~7-10d
: fever · malaise · pharyngitis · eye pain - ↑fever & flu-like sxs few days b4 mucocut findings - early mucosal sxs: odynophagia · photophobia · conjunctival burning/itching · cough · abd pain

symmetric gen erythema or erythematous macules w purpuric centers on face & trunk - nonpruritic but pain out of proportion to exam - descending lesions → vesicles & bullae → slough after few days → painful raw denuded areas - scalp · palms · soles USU spared

TEN: starts as diffusely red sunburn-like tender skin w scattered target lesions & bullae → bullae coalesce → widespread sloughing ← full-thickness epidermal necrosis & detachment - originates face & trunk - ⍉initially on distal extremities - palms/soles rare
- often → pain · poor PO intake · dehydration - most pts - painful sores & crusts on any mucosal surface
: full thickness skin necrosis - partial to full-thickness keratinocyte necrosis of epidermis = definitive
bx distinguishes TEN vs SSSS (thickness & severity of epidermal damage) - direct immunofluorescence → r/o autoimmune blistering (paraneoplastic pemphigus)
: CBC w diff · CMP · ESR · CRP → ID comp (sepsis · lyte & fluid imbalance)
CXR in all pts → r/o pulm comp
worse prognosis: widespread blistering · neutropenia · impaired kidney funct · multi meds · older age
elicit Hx of preceding drug exposure or febrile illness
ddx AGEP (acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis): bx spongiform · subcorneal or intraepidermal pustules - after offending drug - resolves w.o tx after D/C
PROMP DC OF ALL poss INCITING MEDS!!!
- early w.draw optimizes prognosis & prevents reexposure
•admit for inpt monitoring & supportive care (crystalloids) - transfer to specialized center - severe involvement → burn center
•loss of epidermis → massive fluid losses · infect · death
•SCORTEN scale: prognosis & tx setting in adults
: pain mgnt · nutritional support · maintain norm body temp · maintain hydration & lyte balance
•pain: nonopioid (ibuprofen · acetaminophen) - opioids for severe pain
bland emollients/lubricating ointments to involved mucosa
: massive fluid loss → lyte imbalance · hypovolemic shock w kidney dz · bacteremia · insulin resistance · MODS · hypercatabolic state
*recent S. aureus infect ⍉assoc - but subsequent S. aureus infect = common cause of septic shock & death
